shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
repeated row of similar motifs along a band
procession-like alignment of figures in one direction
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief animals and anthropomorphic figures organised with horizontal dividing bands and a repeated row of motifs, but these are generic conventions of relief carving. A depicts a naturalistic narrative procession of robed human tribute-bearers leading a bridled camel, framed by rosette borders, whereas B is a schematic, non-narrative assemblage of predatory quadrupeds, birds, and squatting figures with abstract signs stacked vertically without a shared groundline or human costume detail.
